title: [Livestream 3/1/2025] The changes in a town after the construction of a hydroelectric power dam
prompt: The maps below show the changes in a town after the construction of a hydroelectric power dam. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the transformations that occurred in a town between 1990 and 2010, following the construction of a hydroelectric dam.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Over the 20-year period, the area underwent a major change. The most significant transformation was the development of energy-generating infrastructure where natural landscapes once existed.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: On the western side of the river, the 1990 landscape featured a forest, an ancient structure, and habitats for rare plants and animals. By 2010, all these features were no longer present to give way to transmission towers, though the mountain ranges in the background remained unchanged.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: To the east of the river, the landscape in 1990 was relatively undeveloped, featuring mountains and irrigated farmlands, along with villages. However, by 2010, this area had been dramatically transformed with the construction of a hydroelectric dam and the creation of a large lake. Multiple electricity transmission towers were installed across the region, and the irrigated farmland gave way to a new hotel. Despite these significant changes, the existing villages on this side of the river were also maintained.
